download.title: Get Orb
download.body: Choose your device to download Orb. Store destinations are not connected to this preview. Explore the app experience on this page while the approved links are confirmed.

free-diet.title: Your free diet plan
free-diet.body: The free diet-plan offer is recorded in the existing website configuration. Its live entry link and any account requirement still need to be confirmed. This preview does not create a plan or collect your information.

free-fitness.title: Your free fitness assessment
free-fitness.body: The free fitness-assessment offer is recorded in the existing website configuration. Its live entry link and any account requirement still need to be confirmed. This preview does not assess your movement or collect your information.

daily.title: Daily insights in Orb
daily.body: Explore sleep, activity and your own notes together in the illustrative daily view. The released feature scope and app destination are awaiting confirmation.

nutrition.title: Meal planning in Orb
nutrition.body: The preview shows how preferences, portions, meal records and feedback can shape a routine. The released planning features and destination are awaiting confirmation.

fitness.title: Fitness in Orb
fitness.body: The preview connects movement assessment, workout planning and session logging. Its voice example is simulated. The released training features and app destination are awaiting confirmation.

vault.title: Explore Health Vault
vault.body: The preview illustrates original reports, dates and sources. Supported formats, sharing controls and the Health Vault destination are awaiting confirmation. No report is uploaded here.

integrations.title: Supported integrations
integrations.body: The approved compatibility list is not connected to this preview. Device models, glucose sources, regions and plan eligibility must be confirmed before connecting information.

care.title: Explore professional care
care.body: Professional care is optional and purchased separately. The booking destination, professionals, locations, consultations and follow-up included in each service are awaiting confirmation. No appointment has been booked.

blueprint.title: Explore Blueprint
blueprint.body: Blueprint brings assessment information into professional consultations and next steps. The package details, participating professionals, locations and booking link are awaiting confirmation. An assessment package is separate from a hub membership.

hubs.title: Explore our hubs
hubs.body: Explore assessment and training services connected with Orb. The verified hub locations, local service list and enquiry destination are awaiting confirmation. The setting on this page is illustrative.

family.title: Explore Family Circle
family.body: This preview demonstrates selected summaries shared with people you trust. Released permissions, invitation controls and the app destination require confirmation. No health information is shared here.

pro.title: Explore Orb Pro
pro.body: The annual app price is recorded in the website configuration. Final Free and Pro inclusions, taxes, renewal and cancellation terms are awaiting confirmation. No subscription or payment is started in this preview.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: The approved Orb privacy policy is not connected to this preview. The final policy must describe the released product and its actual information practices.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: The approved Orb terms of use are not connected to this preview. Review the final subscription, renewal and cancellation terms before purchasing.

support.title: Help & support
support.body: The approved Orb help and support destination is not connected to this preview. No support request is submitted here.

contact.title: Contact Cureocity
contact.body: The approved contact destination is not connected to this preview. No enquiry is submitted and no personal information is collected here.

data-requests.title: Data requests
data-requests.body: The authorised Orb data-request destination is not connected to this preview. No access, correction or deletion request is submitted here.

cycle.title: Cycle and personal check-ins
cycle.body: Explore logging periods and symptoms, reviewing your history and estimated upcoming dates. The released feature, eligibility and entry destination are awaiting confirmation.
cycle.note: Upcoming dates are estimates. This preview does not log or store cycle information.

professionals.title: Cureocity for professionals
professionals.body: The professional information and enquiry destination is awaiting confirmation. No enquiry has been sent from this preview.

biological-age.title: Biological age in Orb
biological-age.body: The illustrative screen shows an estimated biological age, not a diagnosis. The released feature, calculation method, required information and eligibility are awaiting confirmation. This preview does not calculate your biological age.
